support: A grayscale starter brand guide for humans and agents — filled example copy you customize.
headline: Populate this guide from your brand
body: Give your agent a source below plus this repo. Fill strategy, voice, visuals, and expressions in brand.md, DESIGN.md, examples.md, and brand/setup.json. Run npm run compile from guide/, then set status to "populated".

sources.label: Website URL
sources.detail: Marketing site, product page, or About page your agent can read.

sources.label: Brand guide PDF
sources.detail: An existing PDF or deck — extract structure, voice, and visual rules.

sources.label: brand.md
sources.detail: A brand constitution file (this repo’s format or a portable brand.md).

sources.label: DESIGN.md
sources.detail: Design tokens and system notes — colors, type, components.

prompt: Using this brand-guide repo and my source (URL / PDF / brand.md / DESIGN.md), populate the guide: update brand.md, DESIGN.md, examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json so every section reflects my brand. Keep the grayscale structure unless my source specifies a palette. Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set brand/setup.json status to "populated".
